verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm whose product is legal services, so asking to read its source code under an open license is a category error. Fenwick Labs builds internal client tools such as trademark extranets, but nothing in the evidence shows any of that software is published as open source. Its open-source legal counsel is advisory work, not a released codebase, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
